message.content: In research_summary.md the bibliography entry labeled "National Laboratory of the Rockies / Best Research‑Cell Efficiency Chart" with URL https://www.nlr.gov/pv/cell-efficiency is wrong/misnamed and therefore non‑reproducible — the authoritative source is NREL's Best Research‑Cell Efficiency Chart (not "NLR") and must be cited correctly. I will replace that entry with the correct NREL citation and URL, record the dataset version/access date, and verify the mirror link actually provides the same certified efficiency table.
